## Validation

- [ ] `node --check server.js`
- [ ] `node --check public/app.js`
- [ ] `node scripts/smoke-test.js`
- [ ] `npm run test:docs` when docs changed
- [ ] `npm run test:community` when marketplace/community/plugin/showcase docs changed

## Safety

- [ ] Workspace file access remains sandboxed.
- [ ] User-visible agent actions still produce receipts.
- [ ] New tools, recipes, or plugins describe permission scope and receipt behavior.
- [ ] Public claims are backed by docs, screenshots, receipts, or benchmarks.
